occupancy: Room-sharing is not uniformly published; Jasper allots one room per resident, while Amber runs mixed single/double sharing across roughly 800 rooms for about 1,600 residents.
messNote: Each hostel runs its own mess/canteen; Rosaline & Ruby's mess hall has separate vegetarian, non-vegetarian and mixed floors, and several halls add canteens for late-night snacks. Meal timings and membership rules are set by individual hostel administrations and not published centrally.
